info.title: dotnet-go
info.description: An optimized runner for C# file-based apps.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Verifies the native toolchain required for native AOT publishes.

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Deletes cached publish artifacts for a file-based .NET app, or for a remote ref.

options.name: --all
options.description: Delete cached artifacts for all apps instead.

commands.name: dev
commands.description: Runs a file-based .NET app from a .cs entrypoint using dotnet run for fast iteration.

commands.name: skill
commands.description: Installs the bundled go-sharp agent skill (SKILL.md) for agent tooling.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Removes a previously installed go-sharp agent skill.

options.name: --r2r
options.description: Publish with ReadyToRun instead of native AOT; supports more dynamic .NET features while keeping most publish optimizations.
